hypothesis: Cell walls in tissue sections meet in threes at about 120 degrees regardless of cell size.
pass_criterion: Mean junction angle is 120 +/- 5 degrees, and its correlation with neighbouring cell area ratio has |r| below 0.2.
fail_criterion: Mean angle deviates by more than 10 degrees, or |r| is above 0.4.
interpretation: Requires measured junction angles from segmented tissue images. No such dataset was fetched.
no_dataset_reason: I did not find and fetch a public dataset of cell-junction angles.
